battleTraits.name: Scions of the Storm
battleTraits.effect: Yndrasta and your Annihilators unit are not set up during deployment. From the third battle round onwards, each can use Lightning-Strike Arrival.

battleTraits.name: Lightning-Strike Arrival
battleTraits.effect: Set up this unit (Yndrasta or the Annihilators, held in reserve by Scions of the Storm) anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units. Only usable from the third battle round onwards.

regimentAbilities.name: Drive Them Back
regimentAbilities.declare: Pick any number of friendly units that are both contesting an objective and in combat.
regimentAbilities.effect: Each of those units can make a pile-in move. For each unit that did so, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a dice: on a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

regimentAbilities.name: Defend to the Last
regimentAbilities.effect: Friendly units have Ward (6+) while they are contesting an objective you control.

enhancements.name: The Prime Huntress
enhancements.effect: The Damage characteristic of Thengavar (Yndrasta's spear) is 2D6 for attacks that target a Monster.

enhancements.name: Strike with the Tempest's Rage
enhancements.effect: Your general has Strike-First if they charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: Dazzling Radiance
enhancements.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they were set up this phase.
enhancements.effect: You can return 1 slain model to each friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase

enhancements.name: Hawk of the Celestial Skies
enhancements.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.
enhancements.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

abilities.name: Champion of Sigmar
abilities.effect: This unit has Ward (5+) this phase.
abilities.timingText: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

abilities.name: Banner of the Reforged
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) the target. In addition, add 3 to that unit's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Force of a Falling Star
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target has Strike-Last this turn.

abilities.name: Lightning Strikes
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's Celestial Greatswords for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

abilities.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
